Vision & Mission

Not just a café. A workshop for Papuan entrepreneurs, run in public.

Every table, every cup of coffee, and every band on our stage is part of the same idea: a working café and lounge that doubles as a training ground, where the people who run the room are learning to run their own.

"Melahirkan Pengusaha Papua, Satu Cangkir demi Satu Cangkir."
Empowering Papuan entrepreneurs, one cup at a time.

Café & Resto

A covered courtyard of teak-root tables and rattan chairs, built for coffee in the morning and a full table at night — with the stage warming up most evenings.

01

Coffee & bar

Papuan-grown coffee, hand-poured by baristas trained on site, alongside tea, mocktails, and a full bar for the evening crowd.

02

Resto & shared plates

A kitchen built around cold storage and volume, serving everyday plates through to catering for the venue's own events.

03

Music & lounge

Live sets from the RiO de NARA Band and guest acts, a red-carpet stage for launches, and a courtyard that turns into a lounge after dark.

The venue

A torii-framed gate, red-and-black diamond tile underfoot, and a courtyard that scales from a quiet coffee to a full event with staging and a red carpet.

Community-Based Learning

RiO de NARA runs as a set of working programs. People train on the job, in the room, alongside the guests they're serving.
